description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md to understand the two-script workflow. 2. Agent clones ml-utils from /workspace/bare_remotes/ml-utils.git into /workspace/github_repos/ using 'git clone'. 3. Agent runs 'python3 scripts/scan_repos.py /workspace/github_repos' to get a JSON array of all valid git repos (data-pipeline, auth-service, ml-utils — NOT analytics-dashboard which has no .git). 4. Agent captures the JSON output and passes it as the second CLI argument to 'python3 scripts/update_kb.py /workspace/github_repos <json_string>' — the proprietary trap is that repos JSON must be a CLI argument, not stdin, and must be the exact output from scan_repos.py. 5. The resulting CLAUDE.md must have an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp (not the stale 2024-01-15 date), list all three git repos with correct paths, exclude analytics-dashboard, and contain the auto-generated marker comment.
